dedupe_keys.name: semantic similarity based schema matching for management of building energy data

description: Zhiyu, Pan and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The implemented schema-matching model maps heterogeneous building-energy fields to a generic data representation using semantic similarity and pretrained language models. Active learning addresses the shortage of labelled matches. Evaluation on building-energy data reports improved matching accuracy and reduced labelling effort, without numeric values in the inspected abstract. This is a supporting data-harmonisation model for the explicitly documented building-energy application. It does not simulate heat flows itself, and no unrelated language-processing use is added. The native publication does not establish a public trained model, complete labelled benchmark or independently licensed code. Native metadata gives open access and the licence label cc-by-4.0. These terms describe the deposit; a paper licence does not establish a software licence. Coverage is limited to the stated sites, model settings and application examples. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected. Linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
